title: Streamlined Computer Coding Apps: Google Adds Antigravity to Gemini App for MacOS
key_facts: Google integrated Antigravity, its agent-first development platform, into the Gemini app for macOS as part of the Gemini 4 Argon rollout on 13 Oct 2026.
Antigravity 2.0 was introduced at I/O 2026 and was previously a standalone app.
A new button in the top-right corner launches the full Antigravity experience inside the Gemini app.
Gemini 4 Argon needs AI Pro or above; Antigravity access requires AI Ultra.
The Mac app also gets a Chat and Task switcher (Task is the new name for Gemini Spark), a Scheduled view, and @ mentions for Skills.
quote_evidence: Google is now bringing Antigravity directly into the Gemini app on macOS.
As of today, the new model requires AI Pro and above in the Gemini app, but Antigravity access requires AI Ultra.
why_it_matters_hint: Coding agent now sits inside Google's main consumer assistant on Mac, for top-tier subscribers.
